key_finding: 91% of platform compounds fail ADMET safety screening. DILI (liver toxicity) is the primary failure mode (84%). Most kinase inhibitors inherently carry hepatotoxicity risk. This validates ADMET-before-docking pipeline order.
implication: Platform compound rankings must integrate ADMET safety scores. Compounds with DILI >= 0.8 should be visually flagged. Only 23/256 compounds are viable drug candidates after safety filtering.
